trigger: A project that installed Change Loop must be made ready for agents: quality lanes and baselines, the feature map, or module boundaries ('onboard this repo', 'ตั้งค่าโปรเจกต์ให้พร้อมใช้ Change Loop', doctor setup rows not ok)
inputs: cloop quality discover output and quality run results
repository routes, commands, tests, docs, and imports
action: Run the deterministic setup steps doctor names, draft the feature map and module boundaries from the code, ask the user to confirm them and to adopt today's findings as the baseline, then verify with features --strict, quality run, and doctor

outputs.description: quality/foundation-quality.json, quality/rule-enforcement.json, and openspec/feature-map.json drafted from the repository
whether today's findings become the baseline, the feature names and paths, and the module boundaries
setup readiness after onboarding with the next command for each remaining row

handoff.when: CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md is missing or stale
the user asks for human onboarding documents
a baseline, feature name, or module boundary needs a decision

aiDoes: runs the setup commands doctor names
drafts the feature map and module boundaries from the code
verifies readiness and reports what remains
humanDecides: whether today's findings become the ratchet baseline
the feature names and their paths
